Path: business objects, records and views | records-forms.view-type-gallery | P2

## Triage: first grade (family closure card) — `bug` · `priority:p2` · `domain:ui` · `area:records` · `pm:queue` (`finding` removed — graded)

Triage: lands in `packages/plugin-timeline/src/ObjectTimeline.tsx` (the fetch commits `setFetchedData(data)` and releases `loading` in `finally` for any run, with no current-run check) ⇒ `domain:ui`; rationale: when the query changes while a read is in flight, a superseded answer that lands later replaces the current rows (measured: `currentShown=false`, `supersededShown=true`). The rows then answer a query the user no longer asked. Runs but answers wrong ⇒ p2, as the gantt twin objectui#10633. `ObjectMap` had the same class and was repaired in PR objectui#10649. No open card carries the run-guard family, so this card is its closure card.

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01CRZSc7dU8oDStbTbSwhuZe` · 2026-09-25T18:34Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch. Read: this card and its full thread, and objectui `origin/main`.

Execution note: scope the rows commit and the `loading` release to the current run, extending the run-sequence ref PR objectui#10680 (merged) added for the `error` writes. Then census the other data views for an unguarded commit, and give each found the same guard. One enumeration pin per view (a superseded answer landing late ⇒ the current rows stay).

Claim: PM loop round 10 — `domain:ui` execution seat 5

Plus the data views the census finds with an unguarded rows commit, each given the same guard, for example in `plugin-calendar`, `plugin-list` (`ObjectGallery`, `ListViewBlock`), `plugin-dashboard` and `plugin-detail`. Pins go beside each, with one `.changeset/10684-…md` `patch` per touched package. ⛔ Not `packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx` (under open PRs objectui#10278 and objectui#10643), and not `packages/plugin-detail/src/DetailView.tsx` (open PR objectui#8941). ⛔ Not `packages/plugin-form/` (this seat's objectui#10682 and PR objectui#10650). A census row that lands in a held file is filed, not edited. ⛔ No fetch-effect dependency list, no `error` lifecycle rework, and no new published prop. Stop on breach; explain in the report.
Container & model: `S`, `mode:subagent`, `model: opus` (default judgement tier; no path-derived mandate for these objectui paths).
Clause-②: no
Thread-read: 5837579248
Serial constraints cleared: the open-PR file lists were re-read in this act at objectui `origin/main` `7afc81d`. The card's serial constraint, PR objectui#10680, is merged (`d435e96`). No open PR touches `ObjectTimeline.tsx`. The held files are listed above and excluded from the surface.

`Clause-②: no`: an answer to a superseded query no longer replaces the current rows. No schema, export or accept set moves.

### Scope

The triage (`5837579248`): 「scope the rows commit and the `loading` release to the current run, extending the run-sequence ref PR objectui#10680 (merged) added for the `error` writes. Then census the other data views for an unguarded commit, and give each found the same guard. One enumeration pin per view (a superseded answer landing late ⇒ the current rows stay).」

⇒ `Fixes #10684`
